# 10 — End-to-End Formula Audit (Sellerboard.com + Sellerboard.io → SOW)

**Version:** v0.3 rev 2 DRAFT — NOT APPROVED (register v0.3) · **Audit cutoff:** 2026-10-10 (baseline 2026-09-10) · **Generated by** `engineering/build_doc10.py` from `engineering/formula_coverage_v02.csv`, `engineering/scope_register.json` and `engineering/golden_vectors.json`. Every count in this document is computed from those files; edit the sources and re-run the script rather than editing this file.

All amounts shown in this document are **synthetic golden-vector values**. No business figures from the Sellerboard screens are reproduced.

**What changed in v0.3 rev 2.** The Owner omitted the marketing function from the build (DC-14), so every formula row now carries a **v0.3 scope**: `IN` (built and tested) or `OMITTED` (marketing, not built; kept here for traceability, §9). All Amazon marketplaces, Walmart, eBay and TikTok Shop moved into R2 (DC-15); two rows were added for them (FA-116, FA-117), both **PROPOSED** (§6); channel coverage is in §7. Ad **spend** is still read, because Sellerboard's P&L has an Advertising line and net profit must match.

## 1. Purpose and method

**Purpose.** Prove that every metric, formula and calculation setting that Sellerboard.com (Amazon) and Sellerboard.io (Shopify) show today has a written, testable calculation contract in the SOW, so that the new application can replace both subscriptions without losing a number the business relies on. The audit also adds the B2B calculations Sellerboard does not have.

**Method.**
1. Inventory every metric, P&L line, KPI and calculation setting from the two authorised read-only sessions in the business's own accounts (2026-09-10 and 2026-10-10), the Sellerboard help centre and blog (to 2026-10-08), the Sellerboard.io site and Shopify App Store listing.
2. Where the screens showed both a result and its components, apply the candidate formula to the displayed components and check that it **matched the displayed values (exact or within display rounding)**. Those rows are class OBS-R. Values were read only to reconcile; none is reproduced.
3. Compare each row with the v0.1 SOW contracts and record its v0.1 status (below).
4. Map each row to a v0.2 calculation contract (CALC-xxx in `docs/04_Calculation_Cookbook.md`) that has at least one synthetic golden vector (GV-xxx in `engineering/golden_vectors.json`), checked by `engineering/reference_calcs.py`.
5. Where the vendor publishes no formula and none could be reconciled, write a transparent PROPOSED rule and state that parity is **not** claimed.

**Evidence classes** (used here and in the scope register):

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| OBS | Observed in the authorised read-only session: a label, control, setting or column was seen. |
| OBS-R | Observed **and** reconciled: the stated formula applied to the displayed components matched the displayed values (exact or within display rounding). |
| OBS+PROP | Observed screen or control, with behaviour that was not exercised and is PROPOSED. |
| DOC | Documented description in the vendor help centre, blog or listing; not observed. |
| DOC-F | Documented with an explicit formula by the vendor. |
| HIST | Historical vendor material only (for example an old blog post); current behaviour unknown. |
| PROP | Proposed by this SOW; Sellerboard has no equivalent (all B2B rows). |
| NF | Not found: the vendor documents no formula and none could be reconciled; the contract is PROPOSED. |

**v0.1 status** describes how the v0.1 SOW covered the row *before* the v0.2 fixes:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| COVERED | A v0.1 contract already defined it the same way. |
| PARTIAL | A v0.1 contract existed but missed an input, option or presentation rule. |
| MISSING | No v0.1 contract. |
| DIVERGENT | A v0.1 contract defined it differently from Sellerboard. |

**v0.3 scope:** `IN` = built, the row's contract is an acceptance contract; `OMITTED` = marketing function removed by the Owner (DC-14), not built; the row, its contract and its golden vectors stay for traceability only (vectors carry the `omitted_v03` marker and run only in `reference_calcs.py`).

**Every row maps to a CALC contract with golden vectors, and no IN row maps to an OMITTED contract** (the generator stops otherwise). Because no application has been built yet, nothing is "implemented"; the golden vectors check the contract arithmetic only.

## 3. One dashboard: Sellerboard-compatible P&L and contribution view

Amazon, Shopify and B2B (R1), and from R2 every other Amazon marketplace, Walmart, eBay and TikTok Shop, appear in **one dashboard** (CALC-101 unified consolidation and channel mix). The P&L can be shown two ways over the **same signed ledger lines**:

**a) Sellerboard-compatible P&L mode (default during the parallel run, DC-08).** Same line names, order and sign convention as Sellerboard, costs negative and summed (CALC-050 gross profit, CALC-051 net profit):

| Channel | Gross profit stack (signed sum) | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Amazon | Sales + Promo + Advertising + Shipping + Giftwrap + Refund cost + Amazon fees + COGS + VAT/GST (output tax) | OBS-R (FA-010) |
| Shopify | Sales + Advertising + Shipping costs + Payment fees + COGS + Tax | OBS-R (FA-079) |
| Shopify — extra lines | Pick & pack and Chargebacks shown separately | **PROPOSED**: Pick & pack was seen only as a settings page; where Sellerboard.io places Chargebacks is a discovery item. An `INFO` note is raised in the parallel run whenever Chargebacks ≠ 0. |
| B2B | Same shape: Sales incl. GST, Tax line, freight borne, COGS (CALC-096), expenses | PROPOSED (no Sellerboard equivalent) |
| Amazon marketplaces other than .in (R2) | Same line structure; tax line by marketplace tax regime (CALC-113) and fee codes from the marketplace master | **PROPOSED / UNVERIFIED** per marketplace (FA-116) — not audited |
| Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop (R2) | Same compat lines; each source fee type mapped by a versioned table (CALC-114); unmapped types → Unclassified fees + `UNCLASSIFIED_FEE` | **PROPOSED** (FA-117) — not observed |

Net profit = gross profit + expenses (signed). Note that in this mode **gross profit already includes advertising and output tax**, as in Sellerboard.

**b) Contribution view (toggle).** CALC-010…CALC-013: product gross profit → contribution before ads → contribution after ads → management net profit. In every market, India included, the base and margin denominator is **net sales excluding output GST/VAT**.

**Reconciliation identity.** Both views sum the same lines, so for identical inputs:

```
GP_compat = GP_CM + Ads        (Ads = the signed Advertising line, i.e. negative)
NP_compat = NP_CM              (equal to the cent; any difference is an S1 defect, RECON_BREAK)
```

- **GV-073** (CALC-050): Amazon compat stack on synthetic inputs → gross profit **7,245.76**.
- **GV-074** (CALC-051): the same inputs plus indirect expenses → compat net profit **2,245.76** = contribution-view net profit **2,245.76** (equal: True).
- **GV-075** (CALC-050): Shopify compat stack → gross profit **11,372.88**.
- **GV-143**: refund single-count rule — the refunded principal is counted once (Sales line *or* Refund cost, set by `refund_principal_in`); both settings give the same gross profit.
- **GV-145**: India Item TDS presentation (`item_tds_presentation` = `in_amazon_fees`, the Sellerboard-compatible default, or `recoverable_asset`) is applied to both views, so the identity holds under either setting; estimated payout (CALC-048) subtracts TDS withheld.
- Amazon shipping and giftwrap charges and chargebacks map to the Shipping and Giftwrap lines (CALC-109, PROPOSED mapping); the "don't show" toggle never changes profit.
- Margin on net sales (CALC-014) and period-end presentation FX (CALC-081) are display settings. Refund booking date (CALC-082) is a versioned booking policy, not a display setting.

## 4. B2B manual sales (not in Sellerboard)

B2B sales are **entered manually** in the application (customers, invoices, credit and debit notes, receipts) with maker-checker approval; a posted document is immutable and is corrected only by a note. B2B appears as its own channel in the unified dashboard. The application does **not** generate IRNs, e-way bills or GST returns; it only raises read-only compliance flags.

| ID | Calculation | Contract | Golden vectors |
|---|---|---|---|
| FA-B01 | B2B taxable value (line + invoice discounts) | CALC-093 — B2B taxable value | GV-105 |
| FA-B02 | GST split by place of supply (CGST+SGST / IGST / export LUT) | CALC-094 — GST split by place of supply | GV-106, GV-107 |
| FA-B03 | B2B net sales, credit notes, freight charged | CALC-095 — B2B net sales | GV-108 |
| FA-B04 | B2B COGS by warehouse batch; FOC/samples to expense | CALC-096 — B2B COGS & free goods | GV-109 |
| FA-B05 | B2B contribution | CALC-097 — B2B contribution | GV-110 |
| FA-B06 | Receivables, TDS withheld, aging, MSME 45-day flag, DSO | CALC-098 — Receivables, aging, DSO | GV-111 |
| FA-B07 | Export invoice FX & realisation | CALC-099 — Export invoice FX & realisation | GV-112 |
| FA-B08 | Dedup vs Shopify draft orders / Amazon Business; intercompany elimination | CALC-100 — B2B dedup & intercompany elimination | GV-113 |
| FA-B11 | Intercompany COGS / unrealised profit elimination | CALC-110 — Intercompany COGS and unrealised-profit-in-stock elimination | GV-148 |
| FA-B09 | Compliance flags: IRN 30-day, e-way bill, HSN rate master | CALC-102 — B2B compliance flags (read-only) | GV-115, GV-144 |
| FA-B10 | Commission, price realisation, ECL provision | CALC-103 — Commission, price realisation, ECL provision | GV-116 |

Key rules (details in the cookbook):
- GST split by place of supply (CGST + SGST intra-state, IGST inter-state, export under LUT); rates come from an HSN master, never hard-coded. Freight follows the principal supply ⚠.
- Duplicate block: a B2B invoice that matches a Shopify draft order or an Amazon Business order is blocked (CALC-100), so the same sale is never counted twice.
- Intercompany sales are eliminated in the consolidated view; unrealised profit in the buying entity's closing stock is eliminated too (CALC-110).
- MSME 45-day flag only when the seller entity is Udyam-registered, the amount is outstanding and age exceeds min(terms, 45) days; TDS only on the value above the per-seller threshold; IRN flags from AATO above ₹5 cr (`IRN_MISSING`), late flag from ₹10 cr.
- Credit-limit warnings and available credit stay off until receipt entry ships in R2, so R1 never shows a false warning.

⚠ GST, TDS, e-invoice and e-way-bill rules are summarised from official sources as of the cutoff and **must be confirmed by the business's CA** before validations go live.

These are **observations to verify, not established facts**. They come from the read-only sessions and may affect the numbers the business sees today. No figures are given. Each item names how the new application handles it.

| # | What was observed | Why it may matter | How the new application handles it | Please check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Shopify shipping costs appear to mirror the shipping amount charged to the customer, and pick & pack appears to be set to ₹0. | Courier, 3PL and RTO costs may not reach profit, so Shopify profit may be overstated. | Actual courier/3PL costs replace profile estimates when matched (CALC-105, GV-117); pick & pack (CALC-021); RTO/COD (CALC-104); a completeness bar shows the share of estimated shipping. | Shipping profile and Pick & pack settings in Sellerboard.io. |
| 2 | The Shopify tax breakdown shows IGST and CGST lines but no SGST line. | Intra-state sales should carry equal CGST and SGST; the GST deduction may be understated. | Output-tax completeness check flags `CGST_SGST_MISMATCH` and `TAX_LINE_INCOMPLETE` (CALC-052, GV-076). | Shopify tax settings and a few intra-state order tax lines. |
| 3 | A large gap was seen between platform-reported ad sales and Sellerboard's attributed sales. | If real, platform-reported ROAS may overstate returns when used for budget decisions. Neither view is "the truth". | The attribution comparison (CALC-061) is **omitted with the marketing function** (DC-14). The application reads ad spend for the Advertising line and shows blended ROAS / MER on total sales (CALC-059), which needs no attribution. | Attribution window and model in each ad platform versus Sellerboard (first / last visit). |
| 4 | The Shopify "Draft orders" sales channel is included in sales. | If B2B orders are keyed as Shopify draft orders, adding manual B2B entry could count them twice. | B2B entries matching a draft order or Amazon Business order are blocked (CALC-100, GV-113); order inclusion rules (CALC-090). | Whether any B2B orders are keyed as draft orders today. |

| 7 | Refund double-count risk: the v0.1 SOW deducted refunded principal both in net sales and in refund cost. | A refund counted twice understates profit. | **Now prevented** by the single-count rule (`refund_principal_in`, CALC-002/004/010, GV-143; cookbook failure-mode row 46). | Nothing in Sellerboard; WP-07 must test the rule. |

Both rows are **IN** and both contracts are **PROPOSED**: Sellerboard documents the marketplace list and the Walmart / eBay / TikTok Shop views, but no per-marketplace tax display and no line-level mapping for those channels was observed (the audited accounts have none of them connected). Parity is **not** claimed; it is checked per marketplace and per channel in a parallel run once Sellerboard data for that account exists, and the tax regimes need CA confirmation (A-22).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FA-116 | .com | Amazon marketplaces across NA/EU/FE (23 listed) incl. tax regime per marketplace (VAT, GST, marketplace-facilitator tax) | DOC | CALC-113 — Marketplace tax regime resolution (all Amazon marketplaces) | GV-152, GV-153 | One tax regime per marketplace and date from the marketplace master (canonical enum `VAT_SELLER \| GST_SELLER \| CONSUMPTION_TAX \| SALES_TAX_MF \| MF_VAT`; flags `REGIME_MISSING`, `REGIME_MISMATCH`, `MF_TAX_NOT_NETTED`). ## 11. Method limits

- Sellerboard.io publishes no formulas and its help centre blocks automated reading, so Shopify-side definitions rest mainly on reconciliation against the business's own screens.
- One Sellerboard.io store (Shopify India) and the Amazon.in Sellerboard.com account were audited. Other Amazon marketplaces, Walmart, eBay and TikTok Shop were not observed; Repricer, Walmart and Search-terms menus were not visible in the audited accounts. Their contracts rest on documentation (DOC) and are PROPOSED where no formula is documented.
- Where a vendor formula was neither documented nor reconcilable it is NF, and the SOW contract is PROPOSED. No vendor formula has been invented.
- OBS-R means the formula matched the displayed values (exact or within display rounding) in the observed cases only.
- Golden vectors are synthetic and test contract arithmetic; they are not a test of an application, which does not exist yet.
